children: Germany and Italy line up for government bond sales on Tuesday, with the former conducting an auction and the latter launching a new green bond via syndication. The German Finance Agency will auction 5 billion euros in October 2031-dated federal notes, known as Bobl, while Italy will syndicate a new October 2038-dated green BTP. Rates strategists at Commerzbank estimate the issue size of the new BTP at 6 billion euros. (emese.bartha@wsj.com)
